neighbours.label: A fractional or multiple comparison of size or amount ('three-quarters of the sun', 'a tenth as heavy as Earth', 'twice the risk', '220% of the risk', '4倍'), firing on 'of', 'as' or 'the' after the fraction or multiple; plain comparisons without a ratio stay quiet.
fire: The moon is about a quarter the width of Earth.
Jupiter is eleven times as wide as Earth.
Smokers face three times the risk of heart disease.
The new tank holds half as much water as the old one.
The house sold for twice its asking price.
Venus is about nine-tenths the size of Earth.
Prices are now 150% of what they were in 2010.
The bridge is one third as long as the tunnel.
quiet: The moon is smaller than Earth.
Jupiter is much wider than Earth.
Smokers face a higher risk of heart disease.
The new tank holds less water than the old one.
The house sold above its asking price.
Venus is similar in size to Earth.
Prices are now higher than they were in 2010.
The bridge is shorter than the tunnel.

short: fraction/multiple comparisons ('a tenth as heavy as')
notes: Card: ' times' x8, ' half' x4, ' of' x3, ' as' x2, Chinese 倍 (three-quarters⟦ of⟧ the sun; 220%⟦ of⟧ the risk; a tenth as heavy⟦ as⟧ the Earth; 欧美国家的4⟦倍⟧). Exploratory probe: 'a tenth as heavy as' 1.35, 'three-quarters of the size' 0.60, 'twice the risk' 0.58; 'close to Earth' 0.004.
